Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Provision of signed and dated informed consent form
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no explicit information about the patient's willingness or availability for the study.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Male or female, aged ≥ 18 and < 71 years
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a 58-year-old male, which fits the age criteria.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with Acute leukemias or T-lymphoblastic lymphoma (T-LBL) in 1st or subsequent CR
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of acute leukemias or T-LBL.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with Acute lymphocytic leukemia (ALL) or T-LBL as defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active extramedullary disease (EMD) (e.g., central nervous system (CNS), soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of ALL or T-LBL.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - No blasts with Auer rods - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active EMD (e.g., CNS, soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of AML.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with Acute biphenotypic leukemia (ABL)/Acute undifferentiated leukemia (AUL) defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active EMD (e.g., CNS, soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of ABL or AUL.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with Myleodysplastic Syndromes (MDS), fulfilling the following criteria: - Subjects with de novo MDS who have or have previously had Intermediate-2 or High-risk disease as determined by the IPSS. Current Intermediate-2 or High- risk disease is not a requirement - Subjects must have < 20% bone marrow blasts, assessed within 60 days of informed consent - Subjects may have received prior therapy for the treatment of MDS prior to enrollment
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of MDS.
There is no information provided about the patient's performance status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Adequate organ function defined as: - Cardiac: LVEF at rest ≥ 35% (RIC cohort) or LVEF at rest ≥ 40% (FIC cohort), or LVFS ≥ 25% - Pulmonary: DLCO, FEV1, FVC ≥ 50% predicted by pulmonary function tests (PFTs). DLCO value may be corrected or uncorrected for hemoglobin - Hepatic: total bilirubin ≤ 2.5 mg/dL, and ALT, AST, and ALP < 5 x ULN (unless ALT, AST, and/or ALP are disease related) - Renal: SCr within normal range for age (see table 5.1B). If SCr is outside normal range for age, CrCl > 40 mL/min/1.73m2 must be obtained (measured by 24-hour (hr) urine specimen or nuclear glomerular filtration rate (GFR), or calculated GFR (by Cockcroft-Gault formula)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is insufficient information to assess the patient's organ function, particularly cardiac function.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Subjects must have the ability to give informed consent according to applicable regulatory and local institutional requirements
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent, indicating the ability to consent.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Availability of deceased HLA MMUD cryopreserved product through Ossium cryobank
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the availability of an HLA MMUD cryopreserved product.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HLA MMUD defined as 4-7/8 HLA-allele matching at MHC class (A, B, or C) or MHC class II (DRB1)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's HLA-allele matching status.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 58 years old, which is well above the pediatric age limit.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the availability of a suitable HLA-matched donor.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of the patient being involved in any investigational drug trials or GVHD clinical trials.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of the patient having any uncontrolled infections.
There is no mention of the patient having undergone prior allogeneic HCT.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Primary myelofibrosis or myelofibrosis secondary to essential thrombocythemia or polycythemia vera
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any diagnosis of primary myelofibrosis or related conditions.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Subjects with MDS may not receive RIC and must be < 50 years of age at the time of signing the informed consent form
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient does not have MDS, so this criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Any condition(s) or diagnosis, both physical or psychological, or physical exam finding that in the investigator's opinion precludes participation
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about any conditions or diagnoses that might preclude participation according to the investigator's opinion.

Recap: The patient meets the age and informed consent criteria but lacks information on willingness to comply, performance status, organ function, and HLA matching. Exclusion criteria are mostly not violated, but some remain unclear due to missing data.
